blocks.text: Welcome, Trainers! These rules apply to our Minecraft server, Discord, and official community events.

blocks.title: Respect Everyone
text: No harassment, discrimination, slurs, threats, bullying, or sharing private information. Respect boundaries and keep disagreements civil.

blocks.title: Keep Chat Appropriate
text: No NSFW or graphic content, spam, excessive caps, or disruptive messages. This includes usernames, skins, builds, signs, and Pokémon nicknames.

blocks.title: Voice Chat Conduct
text: No screaming, mic spam, loud soundboards, disruptive music, or offensive audio. This includes proximity chat. Do not pressure others to speak. Obtain consent before recording anyone.

blocks.title: English in Public Channels
text: Use English in public Discord channels, global in-game chat, and public voice channels so staff can moderate effectively.

blocks.title: No Filter Bypassing
text: Do not use altered spelling, symbols, images, spaces, or audio to bypass chat filters. Prohibited content remains prohibited even if a filter fails.

blocks.title: No Begging
text: Do not repeatedly request Pokémon, items, currency, ranks, gifts, or staff roles. Asking politely once is fine. Harassment or repeated requests are not.

blocks.title: No Impersonation
text: Do not impersonate staff, players, creators, or official accounts. Misleading names, profiles, prefixes, or messages are prohibited.

blocks.title: No Unauthorized Advertising
text: No advertising other servers, communities, businesses, referral links, or social media without staff permission. This includes unsolicited promotional DMs.

blocks.title: No Griefing or Stealing
text: Do not damage builds, steal items, kill another player's mobs, or use their resources without permission. Being trusted in a claim does not give you permission to steal.

blocks.title: Respect Claims & Bases
text: Ask before building or claiming near another player's base. Do not surround claims, block entrances, create traps, or restrict access to public facilities.

blocks.title: No Inappropriate Builds
text: Sexual, hateful, discriminatory, or graphic builds, symbols, signs, books, and map art are prohibited. This includes private bases and claimed land.

blocks.title: Protect Server Performance
text: Lag machines, crash mechanisms, and disruptive builds are prohibited. Follow posted farm and entity limits. Staff may require changes to builds causing significant lag.

blocks.title: Responsible Pokémon Hunting
text: Do not modify another player's land or public areas to manipulate Pokémon spawns. Hunting platforms and farms must follow server limits and must not exploit bugs or obstruct shared content.

blocks.title: Respect Pokémon Encounters
text: Do not catch, defeat, or interfere with Pokémon another player is actively battling or attempting to catch. Standing nearby does not reserve a Pokémon. Follow announced legendary and event rules.

blocks.title: Battle Fairly
text: Minecraft PvP must be consensual. Agree on Cobblemon battle rules and stakes beforehand. No deliberate stalling, trapping opponents, teleport killing, or unfair tactics. Official tournaments follow their own posted rules.

blocks.title: No Teleport Trapping
text: Do not use teleport requests, homes, warps, portals, or other travel methods to lure players into danger, trap them, kill them, or steal their belongings.
blocks.emph: Accepting a teleport request is NOT consent to PvP.

blocks.title: No Cheating or Automation
text: Hacked clients, X-ray, auto-clickers, macros, bots, and tools providing unfair gameplay advantages are prohibited. Open a support ticket before using modifications you are unsure about.

blocks.title: No Exploit Abuse
text: Do not abuse duplication glitches, broken rewards, claim bypasses, or other exploits. Stop using discovered bugs and report them privately through a ticket. Do not distribute exploited Pokémon or items.

blocks.title: Trade Honestly
text: Scamming, fake bids, deceptive listings, and changing agreed trade terms are prohibited.
Clearly disclose Pokémon stats, shininess, forms, items, prices, and loan conditions. Do not rename items to deceive buyers or accept payment without delivering agreed goods.
Return borrowed Pokémon and items as agreed, including those used for breeding, trade evolutions, or Pokédex entries.
Trading server Pokémon, items, or currency for real money is prohibited.

blocks.title: No Account or Reward Abuse
text: Do not use alternate accounts to bypass restrictions, evade punishments, or repeatedly collect one-player rewards. Win trading, fake battles, and artificially boosting rankings or event rewards are prohibited.

blocks.title: Do Not Encourage Rule-Breaking
text: Do not pressure, pay, dare, or instruct others to break rules. Assisting with cheating, griefing, scamming, exploits, or punishment evasion is prohibited.

blocks.title: Report Issues Responsibly
text: Use support tickets to report players, bugs, exploits, or staff concerns. Include evidence when available. False reports, public harassment, and retaliation are prohibited.

blocks.title: Respect Staff & Moderation
text: Follow staff instructions during incidents. Appeals and disagreements must be handled respectfully through support tickets. Do not evade punishments or interfere with moderation.

blocks.text: These rules apply equally to players, supporters, and staff.

items.text: Removal of unfairly obtained items or Pokémon

blocks.text: Punishments depend on severity, circumstances, and repeated behavior. Serious violations may result in an immediate ban.
Rule changes and server-specific limits will be announced through Discord.
Play fairly. Respect others. Help your fellow Trainers.
Thank you for being part of Snobblemon Regions! 💚
